title: Beyond the Lethal Trifecta: Agentic Commerce on the Open Internet — David Levine, Kiduna Club
talk_summary: A pitch for a legal/identity layer (DUNA-registered organizations plus JWT-based agent identity and blockchain audit trails) intended to let agents transact on the open internet past the 'lethal trifecta'.

takeaways.technique: Scoped, short-TTL capability tokens per agent action
takeaways.what_they_do: Agents carry JWT tokens that encode identity, authority, and boundaries, with per-purpose claims and configurable time-to-live, validated before two agents interact.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can create all kinds of different tokens for different purposes and you can set different times to live

takeaways.technique: Treat fetched content as untrusted input to the agent
takeaways.what_they_do: Frames prompt injection as the core risk: agents naively ingest untrusted web/email content alongside private data and action rights.
takeaways.evidence_quote: An agent is incredibly naive. It takes It doesn't do much except take information in as a prompt.
